title: SCHOOL LIFE
location: L04 · SCHOOL EXTERIOR → L05 · CORRIDOR → L06 · CLASSROOM
logline: School as a warm, loud, ordinary ecosystem. Kabir is introduced as the person who makes Ishaan's day survivable.
grade: Slightly desaturated blue-white exterior against warm interior corridors. The school is lighter and cooler than home — the visual argument of the episode starts here.

narration.hi: स्कूल वही था। गेट वही, दीवारें वही, और कबीर भी वही — हमेशा की तरह पाँच मिनट लेट।
narration.en: School was the same. Same gate, same walls, and Kabir the same too — five minutes late, as always.

narration.hi: कबीर से मिलने का मतलब था दिन की पहली हँसी। और वो हँसी हमारे बीच की सबसे पुरानी आदत थी।
narration.en: Seeing Kabir meant the first laugh of the day. And that laugh was the oldest habit we had.

shots.cam: Exterior, drone at 40 m, descending along the school's front axis
shots.move: Slow continuous descend + 15° forward tilt. No orbit, no speed ramp.
shots.action: Students stream through the gate in two directions; a cycle rickshaw waits; a bell tower clock reads 07:52.
shots.env: L04 school: three-storey sand-coloured block, blue-grey roof, a neem tree at the gate, painted boundary wall, dusty playground to the right.
shots.light: Low winter sun behind the building, long shadows toward camera; sky pale, almost white at the horizon.
shots.vfx: Dust in the playground air, light atmospheric haze on the treeline.
shots.cont: ARCHITECTURE LOCK A-04: gate at the south end, main block running north, corridor on the east face, assembly hall to the west. Never rotate this plan.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, tracking backward ahead of him at 1.0 m/s
shots.move: Backward track, matching his walk; crowd crosses between camera and subject twice.
shots.action: Walks through the gate, shifts his bag, sidesteps a running junior, and looks for someone.
shots.expr: Half-awake, then alerting to a familiar face.
shots.env: Gate → front steps, painted wall, students in identical uniforms.
shots.light: Cool daylight, gently overcast; the jacket's red lining is the only warm accent in the frame.
shots.cont: Background students must be visually varied — 10 distinct silhouettes minimum, no identical clones (CONT-BG-01).

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.45 m, at the pillar, side-on to the steps
shots.move: Static; Kabir moves INTO frame from the right.
shots.action: Kabir is leaning on the pillar, sees Ishaan, pushes off it, spreads his arms theatrically, and claps Ishaan's shoulder hard enough to shift him.
shots.expr: Kabir: enormous grin, mouth open mid-laugh. Ishaan: wincing, then laughing despite himself.
shots.env: Verandah pillars, notice board behind, morning light striping the columns.
shots.light: Striped shadow pattern from the pillar row across both characters — identical stripe angle in all shots of this location.
shots.cont: KABIR LOCK: warmer, deeper brown skin than Ishaan; short black hair with a side-swept quiff and faded sides; wider jaw; rounder eyes; one dimple on the LEFT cheek. Outfit: white shirt, navy sweater-vest, maroon tie, sleeves pushed to the elbow, NO jacket. He must never wear anything resembling JKT-BLR-01.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, walking backward ahead of them along the corridor
shots.move: Steadicam backward track, 1.1 m/s, gentle drift; no bumps.
shots.action: Kabir talks with both hands, re-enacts something, trips on a bag, recovers, and keeps talking. Ishaan laughs with his shoulders rather than his mouth.
shots.expr: Comfortable, unforced. Kabir's face does 80% of the work; Ishaan's reactions are the other 20%.
shots.env: L05 corridor: classroom doors left, open verandah right, sunlight in hard rectangles on the floor.
shots.light: Strong side light through the verandah arches; dust visible in the beams.
shots.vfx: Dust in the light beams only.
shots.cont: Their height relationship is locked: Ishaan ~2 cm taller than Kabir; Kabir leans. Never invert this.
shots.friendChemistry: Kabir always walks on Ishaan's LEFT. Keep it.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.60 m, back of the classroom at the door, deep focus
shots.move: Slow 8° dolly right as they enter, settling into a static composition.
shots.action: Students settling — bags dropping, chairs scraping, one student copying homework at speed. The teacher stands at the board, tapping a marker against her palm.
shots.expr: Teacher: patient authority. Students: the universal 8:15 AM slump.
shots.env: L06 classroom: 6 rows of dual desks, blackboard left, window wall RIGHT, door at the back-right, ceiling fans running.
shots.light: Window bank on the right floods the room; left side falls into cool shadow. Sun patches on the right-hand desks.
shots.vo: Silence — let the room establish itself.
shots.cont: SEATING LOCK: Ishaan + Kabir at bench 4, window side. Meera will be seated at bench 2, centre. Do not move anyone.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.10 m, across the desk from the front, low
shots.action: Notebook slides between them. Kabir draws something rude, Ishaan scribbles it out, Kabir flicks a paper ball at the back of a student's head, Ishaan suppresses a laugh by biting his cheek.
shots.expr: Conspiratorial. Eyebrows and cheek muscles only.
shots.env: Desk surface: two notebooks, one geometry box, pen caps, chalk dust.
shots.light: Warm window light on the desk; faces half-lit.
shots.vo: Silence. The comedy must survive with zero audio.
shots.cont: PROPOSED (non-canon, please approve): the paper ball and the rude doodle. Easily removable.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, 3/4 to Ishaan, window behind his shoulder
shots.action: His laugh fades to a neutral face. He looks out of the window at nothing in particular and drums two fingers once on the desk.
shots.expr: The first hint that he is waiting for something he cannot name.
shots.env: Window, the neem tree outside, white sky.
shots.light: Window as the key: 4:1 ratio, soft cool wrap, warm accent from the corridor door.
shots.vo: Silence. This is the plant for Meera's arrival — do not cut it short.
shots.cont: Board must still read the same lesson text as S05-05 (CONT-BOARD-01).
